authority: This file is the normative current-state ledger. Narrative chronology, review-round labels, future-tense prose, and line-number references in research documents are historical and non-normative. Bindings name the code that owns each state; they are not byte pins, so ordinary refactoring does not require a ledger edit.

protocol_v3_1.claim: The v3.1 corpus snapshot, LOBO/RuAA folds, freeze candidates, exact A0 predictions, and associated corpus bytes are immutable historical evidence only. The ineligible-corpus registry forbids their use for any new scientific run.

protocol_v3_2.claim: The repository owner accepted the remediated v3.2 preparation for bounded evaluator implementation. It derives one local, unapproved atomic bundle only from the exact historical parent, excluding turgenev/записки_охотника, serafimovich/у_нас_и_у_них, and sevsky/дон_на_костылях. It binds full NFC author_id/work_slug identities, content isolation, independently reconstructed 252/248/134 folds, and the unchanged 16-cell/11-comparison matrix without stylo_stack. Frozen-input reconciliation binds immutable design-freeze protocol bytes and explicitly validates the already-chunked corpus by its recorded manifest identity; it does not represent that identity as the current runtime. This owner disposition is not a freeze, execution grant, or independent security verdict.

independent_security_audit.claim: The owner terminated the preparation security review. No independent security-audit PASS or equivalent assurance is claimed; evaluator review is bounded to frozen scientific semantics.

evaluator_candidate.claim: The v3.2 evaluator implements the corrected work-level corpus/fold contract. The completed topic-validity comparison is recorded separately below. A confirmatory evaluator is not registered; ordinary diagnostic comparisons do not require the retired confirmatory control plane.

topic_validity_challenger.claim: The current and topic-restricted feature sets use the same A0/A4 training and held-out-work scoring routes. Their aggregate records accuracy, paired prediction transitions and source identities. It does not estimate confidence intervals or authorship probabilities.

topic_validity_execution.claim: All 992 fits completed on 2026-10-03: 248 held-out works, A0/A4 weighting and current/topic_strict features. A0 classified 216 and 218 works correctly; A4 classified 225 correctly with either feature set. The aggregate and checkpoint reduction were verified and the temporary VM/disk removed. This measures known-author benchmark accuracy; it does not establish new authorship results for disputed novels or a confirmatory generalisation claim.

manifest_freeze.claim: No confirmatory v3.2 freeze constant is registered. The completed bounded comparison records its own exact corpus/fold identities in the aggregate; the former v3.1 corpus remains ineligible for new runs.

production_evaluator.claim: No canonical v3.2 production evaluator identity or evidence adapter is registered for confirmatory execution.

preflight.claim: A confirmatory v3.2 preflight is not implemented. The bounded topic-validity runner has its own verified-input preflight.

execution_authorization.claim: No confirmatory v3.2 execution is authorised. The owner authorised and completed the separate bounded topic-validity comparison and subsequently authorised product and methodology improvements.

confirmatory_execution.claim: The former v3.1 confirmatory runner was retired. A future confirmatory study needs an explicit design and implementation; rebuilding that campaign machinery is not a prerequisite for ordinary diagnostic comparisons.

headline.claim: The completed bounded comparison is available for a local editorial draft. Public deployment and push require the owner's separate instruction; historical metrics remain labelled as historical.

ruaa_r1_v5.claim: This bounded exploratory run does not complete or replace the paired audit, is not confirmatory evidence or an external replication, and authorizes no publication or headline.
